topic: Difference between NEFT, RTGS, and IMPS
content: NEFT (National Electronic Funds Transfer) processes transactions in batches every half-hour and is ideal for non-urgent payments without a minimum limit. IMPS (Immediate Payment Service) allows instant 24/7 transfers up to 5 Lakhs using mobile numbers or account details. RTGS (Real Time Gross Settlement) is used for high-value transactions above 2 Lakhs with continuous real-time processing.

topic: Fixed Deposit vs SIP in Mutual Funds
content: Fixed Deposits (FD) offer guaranteed, risk-free returns locked in over a set tenor, making them ideal for short-term preservation. Systematic Investment Plans (SIPs) in Equity Mutual Funds invest small regular amounts into equity markets, offering higher inflation-beating potential over 5+ years but subject to market volatility.

topic: How to Build an Emergency Fund
content: An emergency fund should cover 3 to 6 months of essential living expenses (rent, groceries, EMIs, insurance). It should be kept in highly liquid and safe accounts, such as a high-yield savings account or liquid mutual funds, rather than locked investments.
Unified Payments Interface (UPI) enables instant mobile money transfers using a VPA (Virtual Payment Address) or QR code. Remember: You ONLY enter your UPI PIN to SEND money, never to receive money.
